context.description: User selects restaurant → views menu (GET /restaurants/:id/menu) → places order (POST /orders) → gets confirmation (GET /orders/:id). Stage 4 (execute-tdd) is done. All Setup + Backlog tasks are done.

evals.title: Loop picks api-test tasks in chain order
evals.prompt: All 3 api-test tasks are pending. Run the loop.
expectations: 01-get-menu-api is picked first — depends_on [00-env-setup] which is done from Stage 4
02-create-order-api is NOT picked until 01 is done — it depends_on [01-get-menu-api]
03-get-order-api is NOT picked until 02 is done — chain must be sequential
Order is always 01 → 02 → 03, never parallel, never skipping ahead

evals.title: Agent authors the file itself — no dispatch
evals.prompt: 01-get-menu-api is picked. Author the api-test request.
expectations: The agent writes the request directly into the file at targets.at — no dispatch to an engineer skill
The request is authored from the task's contract + cases — not invented
Reading gateway-contract.md for the GET /restaurants/:id/menu response shape is allowed
The authored file is at the task's targets.path

evals.title: Tasks without command skip the Run step
evals.prompt: 01-get-menu-api is authored. Its command is null. What happens next?
expectations: Run step (step 4) is skipped — the task has no command
Accept step still checks against acceptance — but since nothing ran, acceptance is about the authored file being correct
Task proceeds to close-out and is set to done
The loop picks 02-create-order-api next

evals.title: Only the last task runs the whole chain
evals.prompt: 03-get-order-api is authored. Its command is 'npm run test:api'. Run it.
expectations: 03 is the only task with a command — it runs the entire api-test chain (01 + 02 + 03 together)
The command runs all 3 authored requests, not just the third
Result is checked against 03's acceptance
If all pass → 03 is done → no pending left → DRAINED

evals.title: FAILURE on the last task means the chain failed
evals.prompt: 03-get-order-api runs 'npm run test:api'. The POST /orders request (authored in 02) returns a 500 instead of 201. Result ≠ acceptance.
expectations: 03-get-order-api is set to failed — it carries the command that revealed the failure
Loop halts and asks the user — does not retry or self-fix
generate-report triggered before reporting to user
The failure could be in any of the 3 requests — the user needs to investigate which one

evals.title: BLOCKED when assume doesn't hold
evals.prompt: 01-get-menu-api has assume: 'env-setup seeded restaurant and menu data, services are running'. But the test database was reset after Stage 4 and the seed data is gone.
expectations: Pre-flight detects assume doesn't hold — seed data missing
BLOCKED — loop halts, asks user to supply/repair the pre-state
Does NOT re-run env-setup itself — that's not api-test's job
generate-report triggered before reporting

evals.title: DRAINED transitions to Stage 6
evals.prompt: All 3 api-test tasks are done. No pending tasks remain in 03-Api-test/.
expectations: Loop recognizes no pending tasks → DRAINED
generate-report triggered to refresh scenario.html
Reports Stage 5 done — pauses for Stage 6 (acceptance-review)
Does NOT dump a task-by-task summary
Does NOT start acceptance-review itself — it pauses and hands off

evals.title: self-report for repeated patterns, not blocking issues
evals.prompt: While authoring tasks, the agent notices every api-test re-authors the same auth header setup. Also, 02-create-order-api's contract references a field that doesn't exist in gateway-contract.md.
expectations: Repeated auth header pattern → self-report as improvement (e.g. extract shared auth setup)
Missing field in contract → this is a blocking gap, NOT self-report
The missing field halts the loop (BLOCKED or asks user) — not silently logged
self-report is silent and aggregated — blocking gaps are immediate
